name: Newtime Infrastructure Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1984, Newtime Infra Ltd is
in the business of Real estate and providing Legal & Professional services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company used to be in the development of information technology but currently it deals in various aspects of real estate development, such as land identification and acquisition, project planning, designing, marketing and execution. It aims to develop 'integrated master planned communities' which comprise residential projects with community facilities, retail and commercial developments.
